view: PA (frontal) chest radiograph, erect; "L" side marker in the upper right of the image confirms conventional orientation (patient's left on image right)
technical_quality: Adequate. Good inspiration (approximately 9-10 posterior ribs visible), no significant rotation (clavicular heads symmetric about the spinous processes), adequate penetration (thoracic spine visible through the cardiac silhouette). Scapulae partially project over the lateral upper lung fields. Costophrenic angles and lung apices are included.

devices.type: Implanted subcutaneous venous access port (Port-A-Cath) with attached catheter
devices.location: Port reservoir over the patient's right anterior upper chest wall (right infraclavicular region, roughly the 3rd anterior rib level); catheter loops superiorly over the right clavicle (right internal jugular route) and descends along the right mediastinal border, tip projected over the superior vena cava at approximately the level of the carina; no kink or fracture seen

description_zh: 胸部正面(PA)X光，吸氣量足夠，無明顯旋轉，穿透度適當。右前胸壁可見皮下植入式靜脈輸液座(Port-A)，導管經右頸靜脈路徑向上繞行後沿右側縱膈緣下行，尖端約投影於上腔靜脈，未見扭結。兩側肺野清晰，未見實質浸潤、結節、肋膜積液或氣胸；兩側肋膈角銳利，心臟大小正常，縱膈及氣管位置正常，主動脈弓略為突出，符合年齡變化。兩側下胸部各見一小圓形環狀金屬影，為體外電極貼片等外部物件；骨骼未見急性病變，左上腹可見胃泡及腸氣，屬正常表現。
